articles.title: Ohio Gov-elect Amy Acton on her childhood, an ‘era of change’ & more
articles.titleZh: 俄亥俄州州长当选人艾米·阿克顿（ Amy Acton ）的童年、“变革时代”等
articles.summary:
Ohio governor-elect Amy Acton sits down with CNN’s Jake Tapper for a wide ranging interview about her difficult childhood becoming an election ad, the political winds after the midterms, how she plans to govern for Ohioans and more.

0:00 Acton opens up about her difficult childhood
5:20 What it means to be the first elected woman governor of Ohio
7:01 Acton on an ‘era of change’
16:11 Acton’s first response after seeing Ramaswamy’s ad
26:24 How does Acton plan to govern a now purple state?

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#News #ohio

articles.title: Trump Goes From Acceptance to Denial With Unfounded Rigged Election Claims
articles.titleZh: 特朗普通过毫无根据的操纵选举主张从接受变为否认
articles.summary:
President Trump voiced his midterm election denial out loud  this evening in his impromptu press conference, and the outgoing Republican-controlled Congress moves closer to an impeachment vote on Defense Secretary, Pete Hegseth. Plus, Jensen Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia admits to an extramarital affair but doesn't mention the person he was involved with is now alleged to be a Chinese spy. 


 


Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices (https://podcastchoices.com/adchoices)

articles.sourceNote: Official publisher video · original English audio
articles.readingText:
President Trump voiced his midterm election denial out loud  this evening in his impromptu press conference, and the outgoing Republican-controlled Congress moves closer to an impeachment vote on Defense Secretary, Pete Hegseth.

Plus, Jensen Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia admits to an extramarital affair but doesn't mention the person he was involved with is now alleged to be a Chinese spy.
articles.readingTextZh:
特朗普总统今晚在即兴的新闻发布会上大声否认中期选举，即将卸任的共和党控制的国会更接近于对国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯（ Pete Hegseth ）进行弹劾投票。

此外，英伟达（ Nvidia ）首席执行官黄延森（ Jensen Huang ）承认有婚外情，但没有提到与他有牵连的人现在被指控是中国间谍。
